contract: design-contract.md — NOËL, a real-time winter artwork and personal letter for Si-eun.

accessibility.evidence: Inspected visible focus and readable foreground colors in rendered desktop/mobile views. Native dialogs have headings, labels, Escape dismissal and verified focus return. Actual keyboard events orbit/zoom the tree; buttons expose selected/paused state. Reduced-motion emulation starts a complete, stationary tree and shows a static heart for the explicit letter action. Mobile control height is 44px. This is targeted browser review, not a full WCAG certification. Mobile letter body increased from 11px to 15px. The close button remains 44px and visible while the independently focusable paper scrolls. A 44px read-more button appears only while content remains below.

responsive.evidence: Captured and visually reviewed 1440x900, 390x844 and 360x740 final scenes. Corrected initial title/star and caption/present overlaps. Also inspected 1920x1080 and a scrollable 844x390 landscape layout. No horizontal overflow; controls remain in bounds. Actual two-finger CDP events changed the scene zoom. Follow-up mobile check covers 320x568, 360x640, 375x667, 390x844, 412x915, 430x932 and 852x393. Verified actual illuminated WebGL pixels in a distinct stage, touch scrolling, orientation changes while open, close/reopen and handoff to the wish dialog. The paused/reduced-motion frame survives redundant resize notifications.

loading.evidence: A stable loading marker appears during renderer setup, then becomes hidden to assistive technology and fades after the first real frame. The tree completes its growth and remains interactive.

empty.evidence: The wish field has a prompt. Browser integration checks reject both empty and whitespace-only submissions without closing the dialog.

error.evidence: Tested unavailable WebGL and forced WebGL context loss. A recovery panel replaces the loading state; restoring the context recreates GPU resources and clears the panel.

partial.evidence: Blocked localStorage writes in an isolated browser test. The wish effect still works, with a visible message explaining it cannot persist. HTML-like input remains literal text.

success.evidence: Verified personal letter, held heart, wish persistence after reload and deletion, all palettes/modes, audio on/off, growth/burst recovery and an actual PNG download with a valid file signature.

permission.reason: The artwork uses no account login, camera, microphone or permission-gated external service. Audio is explicitly activated by a button, and all assets are local. Browser-native fullscreen/download availability is handled with feedback.

renderedEvidence.observation: Personal dedication to Si-eun and a complete ASCII tree with gold garland, ornaments, star, presents and visible controls.
Mobile dedication, tree and action controls fit without overlap; touch hint is appropriate for the viewport.
Short mobile view uses a smaller tree to separate gifts from the caption and keeps all primary controls visible.
The requested personal letter appears beside the particle heart; the dialog has a visible close button and a path to leave a wish.
Actual WebGL particle heart sits visibly above the 15px personal letter. Both remain readable; only the paper scrolls if needed. Close control stays visible.
Short mobile viewport: real heart stays above the scrollable letter, with a read-more cue and a fixed close control.
Landscape phone viewport: the visible particle heart and scrollable letter are side by side without overlap.

limits: Chromium browser emulation on macOS; physical iPhone/Android and Safari were not tested. Performance measurement is local, not a cross-device guarantee.
